topics.title: Suits, Phones & Kinison's Weird Calls
topics.summary: During a radio show segment, host Howard discusses his ill-fitting suits and playfully criticizes his father’s frugality. The conversation shifts to callers discussing their favorite shows including the Stern Show and bizarre encounters with Sam Kinison involving naked women, hair weaves, and questionable relationships, alongside David Lee Roth's obsession with the broadcast.

topics.title: Bon Jovi Introductions, Bathroom Stories & Sam Kinison
topics.summary: During the radio show, Howard introduces Bon Jovi and then delves into bizarre anecdotes involving a man named Lonnie who refuses to leave the bathroom. Discussions shift to a documentary featuring Sam Kinison, with commentary on Alan Stephen’s childhood toilet training habits and his intense demeanor.

topics.title: Room Service & Orgy Debates
topics.summary: During a radio show, hosts discuss Sabrina’s romantic life involving multiple women and an orgy. They debate the ethics of it all while playfully teasing about Sam’s involvement and referencing past guests like Brother Dweezel. A phone call reveals one woman is wearing no bra and another has a wallet left open, leading to chaotic conversation regarding room service expenses and personal belongings.

topics.title: Jack Nicholson and Hollywood Women
topics.summary: During a radio show segment, Howard Stern discusses his interactions with Jack Nicholson, describing him as ‘timing’ focused rather than influential. He recounts an encounter involving several women – Malika, Lacey, Sabrina – who were invited to the studio; they watched MTV in a hotel room, engaging in suggestive behavior and discussing celebrity endorsements for Nutri-System while attempting to secure television appearances like Hollywood Squares.

topics.title: Confessions About a Former TV Star - Unfiltered
topics.summary: A former television personality recounts her experiences on the show, detailing frustrations with perceived limitations placed upon her talent, conflicts with colleagues including accusations of manipulation, and potential career paths outside broadcasting. The conversation includes bizarre tangents about personal relationships and inappropriate behavior.

topics.title: Unsettling Interview and a Lester Doll
topics.summary: The broadcast features an awkward interview with Holly, obsessed over a ventriloquist’s doll named Lester who is described in bizarre detail including shaving his head and having flies zapping around him; the host then discusses Bill Murray's percentage-based movie deals before considering outlandish contest ideas involving revealing underwear.
